page.title: MillionSend product updates
page.intro: Occasional emails about new features and announcements. We send a confirmation link first; nothing is stored until you open it, and every email carries an unsubscribe.
page.sent: If that address can receive mail, a confirmation link is on its way. Open it to finish subscribing.
page.confirmed: You're subscribed. Product updates will arrive at this address; every one carries an unsubscribe.
page.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
page.invalidEmail: That doesn't look like an email address.
page.tryLater: Too many requests — try again later.

email.subject: Confirm your MillionSend product updates
email.body: Someone asked to receive MillionSend product updates at this address. Confirm below and you're in.
email.linkFallback: Or copy this link into your browser:
email.ignore: If this wasn't you, ignore this email — nothing is stored until the link is opened.
